panels.description: Employees with at least one shift in the selected month.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT personal_code) AS value FROM attendance_dashboard_records WHERE month_year LIKE '$month' AND has_data;

panels.title: Active Employees

panels.description: Attendance rows with actual shift data.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM attendance_dashboard_records WHERE month_year LIKE '$month' AND has_data;

panels.title: Worked Shifts

panels.description: Total hours worked in the selected month.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(working_minutes), 0) / 60.0, 1) AS value FROM attendance_dashboard_records WHERE month_year LIKE '$month' AND has_data;

panels.title: Total Hours

panels.description: Average duration of a worked shift.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(working_minutes) / 60.0, 2) AS value FROM attendance_dashboard_records WHERE month_year LIKE '$month' AND has_data AND working_minutes IS NOT NULL;

panels.title: Avg Hours / Shift

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM attendance_dashboard_records WHERE month_year LIKE '$month' AND has_data AND is_evening_start;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM attendance_dashboard_records WHERE month_year LIKE '$month' AND has_data AND is_overnight;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM attendance_dashboard_records WHERE month_year LIKE '$month' AND has_data AND missing_leave;

panels.description: Worked shifts at 10 hours or more.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM attendance_dashboard_records WHERE month_year LIKE '$month' AND has_data AND is_long_shift;

panels.title: 10h+ Shifts

targets.rawSql: SELECT record_date AS time, COUNT(*)::double precision AS value FROM attendance_dashboard_records WHERE month_year LIKE '$month' AND has_data GROUP BY record_date ORDER BY record_date;

SELECT record_date AS time, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(working_minutes), 0) / 60.0, 2)::double precision AS value FROM attendance_dashboard_records WHERE month_year LIKE '$month' AND has_data GROUP BY record_date ORDER BY record_date;

panels.description: Daily count of high-signal attendance exceptions.

targets.rawSql: SELECT record_date AS time, 'Overnight shifts' AS metric, COUNT(*)::double precision AS value FROM attendance_dashboard_records WHERE month_year LIKE '$month' AND has_data AND is_overnight GROUP BY record_date UNION ALL SELECT record_date AS time, 'Missing leave' AS metric, COUNT(*)::double precision AS value FROM attendance_dashboard_records WHERE month_year LIKE '$month' AND has_data AND missing_leave GROUP BY record_date UNION ALL SELECT record_date AS time, '10h+ shifts' AS metric, COUNT(*)::double precision AS value FROM attendance_dashboard_records WHERE month_year LIKE '$month' AND has_data AND is_long_shift GROUP BY record_date ORDER BY 1, 2;

panels.title: Daily Exceptions

panels.description: Employees with the highest exception counts for manager review.

targets.rawSql: SELECT personal_code AS id_number, full_name AS employee, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE has_data) AS shifts, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_overnight) AS overnight_shifts, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE missing_leave) AS missing_leave, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_long_shift) AS long_shifts, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_short_shift) AS short_shifts, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(working_minutes), 0) / 60.0, 2) AS total_hours FROM attendance_dashboard_records WHERE month_year LIKE '$month' AND has_data GROUP BY personal_code, full_name HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_overnight OR missing_leave OR is_long_shift OR is_short_shift) > 0 ORDER BY missing_leave DESC, overnight_shifts DESC, long_shifts DESC, short_shifts DESC, total_hours DESC, employee LIMIT 20;

panels.title: Risk Leaders

panels.description: Employees carrying the most work across the selected month.

targets.rawSql: SELECT personal_code AS id_number, full_name AS employee, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE has_data) AS shifts, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_evening_start) AS evening_starts, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_long_shift) AS long_shifts, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(working_minutes), 0) / 60.0, 2) AS total_hours, ROUND(AVG(working_minutes) / 60.0, 2) AS avg_shift_hours, ROUND(MAX(working_minutes) / 60.0, 2) AS longest_shift_hours FROM attendance_dashboard_records WHERE month_year LIKE '$month' AND has_data GROUP BY personal_code, full_name ORDER BY total_hours DESC, long_shifts DESC, employee LIMIT 20;

panels.title: Hours Leaders

panels.description: Manager rollup by employee for the selected month.

targets.rawSql: SELECT personal_code AS id_number, full_name AS employee, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE has_data) AS shifts, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(working_minutes), 0) / 60.0, 2) AS total_hours, ROUND(AVG(working_minutes) / 60.0, 2) AS avg_shift_hours, ROUND(MAX(working_minutes) / 60.0, 2) AS longest_shift_hours, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_evening_start) AS evening_starts, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_overnight) AS overnight_shifts, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE missing_leave) AS missing_leave, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_long_shift) AS long_shifts FROM attendance_dashboard_records WHERE month_year LIKE '$month' AND has_data GROUP BY personal_code, full_name ORDER BY total_hours DESC NULLS LAST, employee;

panels.title: Manager Summary By Employee

panels.description: Rows that deserve manager review first.

targets.rawSql: SELECT record_date, personal_code AS id_number, full_name AS employee, commute_time AS start_time, CASE WHEN normalized_leave_time <> '' THEN normalized_leave_time ELSE time_to_leave END AS leave_time, working_hours_label AS working_hours, TRIM(BOTH ', ' FROM CONCAT_WS(', ', CASE WHEN missing_leave THEN 'Missing leave punch' END, CASE WHEN is_overnight THEN 'Overnight shift' END, CASE WHEN is_long_shift THEN '10h+ shift' END, CASE WHEN is_short_shift THEN 'Short shift under 4h' END)) AS issue FROM attendance_dashboard_records WHERE month_year LIKE '$month' AND has_data AND (missing_leave OR is_overnight OR is_long_shift OR is_short_shift) ORDER BY record_date DESC, missing_leave DESC, is_overnight DESC, working_minutes DESC NULLS LAST, employee LIMIT 100;
